A FEW GOOD QUESTIONS

About AaloDot

Clear answers for families and schools.

Ask another question
What is AaloDot?+

AaloDot is AaloPro’s planned AI learning device for primary and secondary students. The concept combines voice interaction, curriculum-aligned learning and a screen-free design.

Is AaloDot available now?+

No. AaloDot is still in the planning stage. AaloPro aims to build it by early 2027; this is a target, not a confirmed launch date.

Will AaloDot need a screen or internet connection?+

The planned design is screen-free and intended to work without a cloud connection. Final hardware, setup and connectivity requirements will be confirmed as the product develops.

What is the planned price of AaloDot?+

The planned prices are US$39 for the primary version and US$49 for the secondary version. These are planning-stage prices, and final pricing and availability are not yet confirmed.

Which curricula and languages will AaloDot support?+

AaloDot is intended for curriculum-aligned learning, but its specific curricula and supported languages are not yet confirmed. The AaloApp editions do not imply the same coverage for AaloDot.

How can my school express interest?+

Email help@aalopro.com to discuss your school’s needs or express interest in AaloDot. This is an enquiry, not an order or a preorder.
